Stack modifications, October 2026: floating-point CPU references and OpenGL
compute passes; explicit input ownership and cancellation; mirrored Bayer
boundaries; preservation of negative, above-white and recorded channel values;
camera-calibrated floating-point Lab analysis; separate VNG green phases.

The covered source files are supplied with this application under
LibRawDemosaicSource/, next to this notice. They are also available in the
Stack source distribution under src/Raw/Demosaic/:

    ClassicDemosaicTerms.h
    GpuClassic.cpp
    GpuClassicShaders.h
